products.name: GitBot
products.tagline_zh: Build bots on the coding agent you already use
products.description_zh: GitBot turns a job you keep giving Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode into a bot. Write the instructions once, set what it may touch, and run it in any repo. Each run is a thread you can come back to. Install bots other devs made from the Library, or share yours with a code. products.name: OpenShip
products.tagline_zh: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in.

Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.
